name: openvino
description: OpenVINO™ is an open source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference
one_liner: Software that makes AI models run fast and cheap on ordinary computers and small devices, instead of needing expensive cloud GPUs.
buyer: A hardware integrator or systems consultant building AI features into kiosks, cameras, or retail devices who wants to avoid ongoing cloud GPU bills.
business_use_cases: A systems integrator builds a retail theft-detection camera box that runs AI locally instead of paying for cloud inference per store.
A field-service company builds an offline AI assistant for technicians' laptops that works without internet connectivity.
A kiosk vendor adds local AI-powered product recognition to a self-checkout device without per-transaction cloud costs.

money_ideas.idea: One-off hardware-plus-software bundle sales to retailers or factories needing on-device AI
Subscription for managing and updating a fleet of edge-AI devices

steal_this: Build one niche 'offline AI camera box' for a single vertical, like retail shrink detection, and sell it as a hardware-plus-setup package.
